description: Defines the interface for a ZoneInfoSource class used to provide timezone data, including virtual methods for reading data, skipping data, and retrieving version info. Also declares a factory function pointer for creating ZoneInfoSource instances based on zone names.

classes.name: ZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Abstract interface for providing timezone information data, with methods for reading, skipping, and versioning.

methods.name: ~ZoneInfoSource
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the ZoneInfoSource interface.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, similar to fread().

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the data stream, similar to fseek().

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns version information for the zoneinfo data, default implementation returns an empty string.
